fact: Car 81 collided with Car 23 in Turn 10
offence: Breach of Appendix L, Chapter IV, Article 2 d) of the FIA International Sporting Code.
reason: The Stewards reviewed positioning/marshalling system data, video, and in-car video evidence. Car 81 attempted to overtake Car 23 and did not, according to the Driving Standards Guidelines, have the right to the corner. Car 81 collided with Car 23 and hence was determined to be wholly to blame for the incident.
stewards: in accordance with Article 15 of the FIA International Sporting Code
are based solely on the relevant regulations
title: Infringement Car 81 Collision With Car 23
to: The Team Manager, McLaren Mastercard F1 Team
